basic_info.description: This remarkable home is situated on one of the most iconic and desirable blocks on the Great Highway. Front row seats to unobstructed views of the Pacific from this classic Ocean Beach cottage. Two bedrooms and one bath on the main level and a bonus bedroom with 1/2 bath in the lower level. Brick and tile fireplace, spacious two-car garage and a massive back yard to play in now while you plan for the future. The back yard stretches from the Lower Great Highway, street to street, to 48th avenue. With extremely rare frontage on both the Great Highway and 48th Avenue, just imagine all the possibilities. Restaurants, shops, markets, highly regarded schools, Golden Gate Park, The Zoo, Ortega Library, Sunset Farmer's market...whale watching from your own living room! You've been waiting for this. Surf's up!
